page.overview:
What is Rhydon?

It is a gray rock-hard Pokémon that developed a long tail and learned to stand bipedally, meaning on two legs. It is a rhinoceros-like creature that can crush rocks and has a long drill that can drill through rocks.

Male Rhydon have a longer horn while female have a shorter horn. This is the same case for its pre-evolution and evolution.

This Pokémon's brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock, even diamonds. Records show it as being able to topple buildings with a sweeping blow of its tail. Its hide is so thick and protective that Rhydon can thrive in very hot places, as well as being almost impossible to hurt in battle, at the cost being unable to sense its surroundings.

Despite being a rock-type as seen with Pietra's Rhydon, they can actually swim if they put their mind to it or if they are hungry enough let alone learn water types moves.
